summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, plus thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) set and cleared in run_async. Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 7 tests, all passing when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the repo src. Caveats: the venv imports textual from the base copy unless PYTHONPATH is set; the wider suite has pre-existing failures from missing pytest-asyncio (async tests) and missing aiohttp (tests/devtools), and tests/cli fails to collect; run_test does not go through run_async, so call_from_thread reports not running there. Nothing committed.
